title: MXL - Replication
description: MXL flow replication between nodes: topology, throughput, loss, latency and the control plane.

list.name: Replicator rollout
list.expr:
count by (version) (mxl_repl_build_info{app_kubernetes_io_component="server"})
unless count by (version) (mxl_repl_build_info{app_kubernetes_io_component="server"} offset 5m)

panels.title: Leader
panels.description: Server replicas that currently hold leadership. Exactly 1 is healthy.

targets.expr: sum(mxl_repl_leader) or vector(0)

panels.title: Agents
panels.description: Agents holding a liveness lease, against nodes with a registration record.

targets.expr: max(mxl_repl_agents_leased)
max(mxl_repl_nodes_registered)

panels.title: Requests not active
panels.description: Replication requests in any state other than ACTIVE: DEGRADED, PARTIAL, FAILED, WAITING, ESTABLISHING, PAUSED, DISABLED or INVALID.

targets.expr: sum(mxl_repl_requests{state!="ACTIVE"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Paths active
panels.description: A path is one flow replicated to one target node.

targets.expr: sum(mxl_repl_paths{state="ACTIVE"})
sum(mxl_repl_paths{state!="ACTIVE"})

panels.title: Sessions not ready
panels.description: Session endpoints whose worker is starting or failed, plus sessions frozen because an endpoint's agent lost its lease.

targets.expr: sum(mxl_repl_sessions{state!="ready"}) + sum(mxl_repl_sessions_frozen)

panels.title: Replicated throughput
panels.description: Received by all targets of the selected edges. Video uses the on-wire estimate (grain plus a 4 KiB header), audio is samples × channels × 4 B.

targets.expr:
sum(
label_replace(
  ((rate(mxl_payload_octets_total{direction="target", node=~"$dst", format=~"$format", format="video"}[5m])
   or rate(mxl_octets_total{direction="target", node=~"$dst", format=~"$format", format="audio"}[5m])
      * on(flow_id, node) group_left() max by (flow_id, node) (mxl_flow_channels_total) * 4))
  * on(session) group_left(src) group by (session, src) (label_replace(mxl_grains_total{direction="initiator", node=~"$src"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)")),
  "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)")
) * 8

panels.title: Worst session loss
panels.description: Highest share of media a target did not receive over the last 5 minutes, across sessions. Audio counts samples, video counts grains.

targets.expr:
max(
label_replace(
  (rate(mxl_grains_lost{direction="target", node=~"$dst", format=~"$format"}[5m]) / (rate(mxl_grains_lost{direction="target", node=~"$dst", format=~"$format"}[5m]) + (rate(mxl_octets_total{direction="target", node=~"$dst", format=~"$format", format="audio"}[5m])
   or rate(mxl_grains_total{direction="target", node=~"$dst", format=~"$format", format="video"}[5m]))))
  * on(session) group_left(src) group by (session, src) (label_replace(mxl_grains_total{direction="initiator", node=~"$src"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)")),
  "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)")
)

panels.title: Target restarts (1h)
panels.description: Sessions whose target changed epoch in the last hour. Each one is a target worker that restarted, as seen by the server.

targets.expr: sum(increase(mxl_repl_epoch_transitions_total{node=~"$dst"}[1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Topology (Gb/s)
panels.description: Nodes are MXL hosts with the bandwidth they receive (in) and send (out). The ring shows the same split: blue received, magenta sent. Each line joins two nodes that replicate flows. Its color is the worst loss of any format in either direction: green below 0.1%, amber and dashed below 2%, red and dotted above. Hover a line or node for the rate in each direction. Rates and loss cover the last 30 seconds.

panels.title: Media age on arrival (p99): $format
panels.description: Time between the grain's timestamp and its arrival at the target, p99 of the worst session per edge. Includes the source's own latency and every hop before this one. The sessions table has p50 per session.

targets.expr:
max by (src, dst) (
label_replace(
  (mxl_source_latency_ns{direction="target", node=~"$dst", format=~"$format", quantile="0.99"})
  * on(session) group_left(src) group by (session, src) (label_replace(mxl_grains_total{direction="initiator", node=~"$src"}, "src", "$1", "node", "(.*)")),
  "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)")
) / 1e6

  "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)")
  * on(flow_id, dst) group_left(flow_group_name, flow_group_type)
  label_replace(group by (flow_id, node, flow_group_name, flow_group_type) (mxl_flow_metadata{node=~"$dst"}), "dst", "$1", "node", "(.*)")
) / 1e6

max by (session, flow_id, format, domain, src, dst, flow_group_name, flow_group_type) (

) / 1e6

)

panels.title: Reconcile duration
panels.description: Time for one load, compute and apply pass of the leader.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(mxl_repl_reconcile_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(mxl_repl_reconcile_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Reconciles by outcome
panels.description: ok, refused (leased agents but no observed state) or failed.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(mxl_repl_reconciles_total[$__rate_interval]))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, operation) (rate(mxl_repl_store_operation_duration_seconds_bucket[$__rate_interval]))) > 0

panels.title: Events recorded
panels.description: Event-log entries per interval, grouped: flows and domains appearing or disappearing; worker starts, exits and session changes; path and request state changes; node registration, leases and leadership.

targets.expr: sum by (category) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(increase(mxl_repl_events_recorded_total[$__interval]), "category", "flows and domains", "kind", "flow_.*|domain_.*"), "category", "workers and sessions", "kind", "worker_.*|session_.*|expansion_.*|assignment_.*"), "category", "state changes", "kind", "path_state_changed|request_state_changed"), "category", "cluster", "kind", "node_.*|reconciler_.*|inventory_.*"))

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Target restarts per interval by the node hosting the target, from the server's epoch tracking.

targets.expr: sum by (node) (increase(mxl_repl_epoch_transitions_total{node=~"$dst"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Events dropped
panels.description: Event-log entries lost, by where: queue, ring, store or contention.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (increase(mxl_repl_events_dropped_total[$__interval]))
